text:
maria: @raj quick ask — neighbor emergency, need to head out in ~20m. Can you cover my 21:00–01:00 UTC window? I can take 05:30–09:00 back. Leaving a short handoff below :pray:

maria: Handoff gist:
- Main risk: increased latency if us-west p4 pool gets saturated (we've seen spikes on similar weekend nights).
- Priority: keep hosted API healthy (latency < 350ms), avoid rolling infra changes, escalate to infra if GPU OOMs.
- Quick check list: `curl -s https://console.redwood.ai/api/health | jq .` then `curl -s https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?service=serving | jq .`

maria: Prewarm and warmup steps (do these after you take the handoff):
```bash
# run from devbox
./scripts/prewarm_model.sh --model redwood-3b-quant --concurrency 6 --requests 20
# quick health
curl -fS https://us-west.serving.redwood.ai/health || echo 'health failed'
```

maria: Watchlist (what to watch for):
- Redis queue length (/workload/ingest) > 5000 -> page infra-team.
- P50 token latency creeping > 300ms or error rate > 1% -> start fallback.
- Autoscaler flapping: if pods rapidly spin up/down, set min_replicas=1 for affected pool via console.

raj: I can take it. Two quick q's: 1) Is there a scheduled deploy tonight? 2) Any special customer tests running?

maria: 1) Deploy at 23:45 UTC to staging only, infra said no prod deploys until morning. 2) No enterprise smoke tests tonight — only background batch reranks at 02:00 UTC (low priority).

raj: Got it. I'll do the prewarm and monitor. If I see KV cache misses spike I'll try one small restart of the serving pod and message here.

sophia: Also FYI — if you need to reduce cost/noise temporarily, you can toggle the routing policy to prefer quantized variants: route policy name is `quant-pref-noncritical` in Console. Don't change routing unless latency > 500ms consistently.

dave: Note: if you have to failover, use the `fallback: redwood-1.5b-quant` route. It adds 60–80ms but keeps throughput. Steps: Console -> Routes -> create override -> set fallback. Ping me if you need help.

raj: copying handoff into my personal notes. I'll post a short status update every 30m while I'm onwatch.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled infra maintenance window starts 02:15 UTC (low-impact) — no node drains expected. Contact eng-infra if anything changes.

maria: Thanks @raj, really appreciate it — leaving now :wave:. I'll be reachable by phone if anything critical comes up.

raj: Good luck, safe. Starting prewarm now. First status in 10m.
